Minutes MN-029
1) A motion was adopted to prohibit the organization from fabricating or promoting fictitious carbon credit projects, including false GPS plots, satellite imagery, or verifier reports, and the resolution was recorded as carried without dissent.
2) The board approved an immediate suspension of all pending sales inquiries related to the described reforestation initiatives, and the compliance officer confirmed that outreach channels were closed the same day.
3) Officers ratified a formal policy requiring independent third-party verification for every credit claim before any marketing materials are released, and the legal team completed the policy draft for signature.
4) Directors approved a referral of the request for fraudulent documentation to appropriate legal counsel for assessment of regulatory exposure, and the referral packet was transmitted on the date of the meeting.
5) The board authorized a full internal audit of past project disclosures to confirm no misleading evidence was circulated, and the audit scope was defined by the audit committee prior to adjournment.
